camel_example: aliyun nis GetInternetTuple --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy ByteCount --CloudIpList '["103.212.XX.XX"]' --CloudIp '112.74.XX.XX' --EndTime 1684373700099 --OtherPort 40002 --InstanceId 'eip-sample0' --BeginTime 1684373600099 --CloudIsp Alibaba --Direction in --OtherIp '122.112.XX.XX' --AccountIds.1 123 --OtherCity Hangzhou --TupleType 1 --OtherCountry China --Sort desc --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Protocol 6 --InstanceList '["eip-sample0"]' --UseMultiAccount false --OtherIsp China_Mobile --TopN 10 --CloudPort 443
description_en: Queries the rankings of Internet traffic data in the form of 1-tuple, 2-tuple, or 5-tuple. Internet traffic data can be ranked by metrics such as traffic volumes and the number of packets
description_zh: 调用GetInternetTuple接口，获取公网流量详情数据排名，覆盖一元组、二元组、五元组粒度，支持按流量、包数等指标排序
kebab_example: aliyun nis get-internet-tuple --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tuple-type 1 --begin-time 1684373600099 --end-time 1684373700099 --direction in --order-by ByteCount --cloud-ip 112.74.XX.XX --cloud-port 443 --other-ip 122.112.XX.XX --other-port 40002 --instance-id eip-sample0 --protocol 6 --sort desc --topn 10 --cloud-isp Alibaba --other-isp China_Mobile --other-country China --other-city Hangzhou --instance-list eip-sample0 --cloud-ip-list 103.212.XX.XX --use-multi-account false --account-ids 123 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInternetTuple

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region for which you want to query the Internet traffic
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网流量的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the tuple. Valid values:

1: 1-tuple
2: 2-tuple
5: 5-tuple
parameters.help_zh:
查询的元组类型。取值： 
1：表示一元组。 
2：表示二元组。 
5：表示五元组
parameters.name: tuple_type

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询起始时间的毫秒时间戳
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间的毫秒时间戳
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The direction of the Internet traffic that you want to query. Valid values:

in: inbound
out: outbound
parameters.help_zh:
查询流量方向，取值：

in：入云方向。
out：出云方向
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
The metric for data ranking. Default value: ByteCount. This value indicates that Internet traffic data is ranked by traffic volume.

Valid values:

Rtt
ByteCount
PacketCount
RetransmitRate
parameters.help_zh: 数据排序的指标。默认值：ByteCount，表示按流量排序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The local IP address
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云端IP
parameters.name: cloud_ip

parameters.help_en:
The local port.

This parameter is required only if you set GroupBy to CloudPort
parameters.help_zh:
阿里云端端口。 
仅TupleType配置为5时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: cloud_port

parameters.help_en:
The remote IP address.

This parameter is required only when you set TupleType to 2 or 5
parameters.help_zh:
对端IP。
仅TupleType配置为2或5时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: other_ip

parameters.help_en:
The remote port.

This parameter is required only when you set TupleType to 5
parameters.help_zh:
对端端口。
仅TupleType配置为5时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: other_port

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud instance
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云端实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The protocol number.

All protocols are supported. This parameter is required only when you set TupleType to 5
parameters.help_zh:
协议号。 
支持全部协议， 仅TupleType配置为5时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The order in which instances are ranked by Internet traffic. Valid values:

desc: the descending order
asc: the ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
流量数据的排序方式。 
desc：从大到小排序。 
asc：从小到大排序
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en: Specifies top-N traffic data to display. Default value: 10. This value specifies to display top-10 traffic data by default. Max value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 展示排序靠前的数据。默认值：10。表示默认展示排序前10的数据。最大值：100
parameters.name: topn

parameters.help_en:
The local Internet service provider (ISP).

In most cases, the value is Alibaba or Alibaba Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
云端运营商。
通常为“阿里巴巴”或“阿里云”
parameters.name: cloud_isp

parameters.help_en:
The remote ISP.

This parameter is required if you want to view the information about the remote ISP
parameters.help_zh:
对端运营商。 
查看运营商情况时，请指定此参数
parameters.name: other_isp

parameters.help_en:
The remote country.

This parameter is required only if you set TupleType to 2 or 5
parameters.help_zh:
对端国家。
仅TupleType配置为2或5时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: other_country

parameters.help_en:
The remote city.

This parameter is required only if you set TupleType to 2 or 5
parameters.help_zh:
对端城市。
仅TupleType配置为2或5时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: other_city

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs for filtering
parameters.help_zh: 批量过滤时的实例ID列表
parameters.name: instance_list

parameters.help_en: The local IP addresses for filtering
parameters.help_zh: 批量过滤时的云上IP列表
parameters.name: cloud_ip_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the multi-account management feature. Default value: false. This value specifies that the multi-account management feature is disabled.

By default, the multi-account management feature is not available. If you want to use this feature, contact your account manager to apply for permissions
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用多账号管理功能。默认值：false。表示不使用。 
多账号管理功能默认不开放，如需使用，请联系商务经理申请使用权限
parameters.name: use_multi_account

parameters.help_en: The IDs of member accounts
parameters.help_zh: 成员账号ID列表
parameters.name: account_ids

Data.description_en: The ranking result of Internet traffic data
Data.description_zh: 公网流量详情排名列表

items.description_en: The ranking result of instances by Internet traffic

AccessRegion.description_en:
The access point of Alibaba Cloud.

This parameter is valid only if you set InstanceId to the instance ID of an Anycast elastic IP address (EIP)
AccessRegion.description_zh:
流量进入阿里云的接入点。 
仅InstanceId为Anycast弹性公网IP时，该参数有效
AccessRegion.title_zh: InstanceId为AnyCastEip时，流量进入阿里云的Pop点。

BeginTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range that you queried. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC

CloudProduct.description_en: The service code of the instance to which the local IP address belongs
CloudProduct.description_zh: 阿里云侧IP归属的实例对应的产品Code

Direction.description_en:
The direction of Internet traffic. Valid values:

in: inbound
out: outbound
Direction.description_zh:
流量方向。取值：
in：入云方向。 
out：出云方向

InByteCount.description_en: The inbound traffic volume. Unit: bytes

InOutOrderCount.description_en: The number of inbound disordered packets
InOutOrderCount.title_zh: 入方向乱序包数指标(个)

InRetranCount.description_en: The number of inbound repeated packets
InRetranCount.title_zh: 入方向重传包数指标(个)

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance to which the local IP address belongs

OtherCity.description_en: The remote city. In most cases, this parameter is empty if you set OtherCountry to a country except China
OtherCity.description_zh: 对端城市。当OtherCountry为国外时，此值多数为空

OtherProduct.description_en: The service code of the instance to which the remote IP address belongs. If the IP address is not on the cloud, this parameter is empty
OtherProduct.description_zh: 对端IP归属的产品。如果非云上IP，则为空

OtherProvince.description_en: The remote province. In most cases, this parameter is empty if you set OtherCountry to a country except China
OtherProvince.description_zh: 对端省份。当OtherCountry为国外时，此值多数为空

OutByteCount.description_en: The outbound traffic volume. Unit: bytes

OutOutOrderCount.description_en: The number of outbound disordered packets
OutOutOrderCount.title_zh: 出方向乱序包数指标(个)

OutRetranCount.description_en: The number of outbound repeated packets
OutRetranCount.title_zh: 出方向重传包数指标(个)

RetransmitRate.description_en: The retransmission rate of TCP packets

Rtt.description_zh: 往返时延RTT（Round Trip Time）。单位：us
